project.name: JeanLoa Portfolio
project.description: A structured portfolio for complete software products, AI engineering, internships, university systems, independent practice, courses and academic records.

stack.runtime: static HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript

existingComponents: fixed editorial header and mobile navigation drawer
category section headers and disclosure controls
decisions: Preserve a white, black and warm off-white editorial foundation.
Use color primarily as category identity, never as the only information carrier.
Keep every trajectory as an explicit section.
Present the portfolio as a body of complete engineering work, not as a SaaS landing page.
Prioritize project evidence, implementation state, media and repository links.
Use verified interface captures as project covers and case-study evidence; never substitute unrelated figures silently.
Do not publish project video players; source recordings remain outside deployable assets.
Reuse existing render functions and CSS layers before introducing new primitives.
Use only COMPLETED and PENDING as visible project states.
Omit project-state pills for courses, collections and academic records.
Respect keyboard navigation, visible focus, touch targets and reduced motion.
constraints: Do not merge all work into an undifferentiated card gallery.
Do not invent experience, technologies, results, deployments or projects.
Do not use excessive glassmorphism, 3D effects, strong glow or decorative gradients.
Do not use emoji as interface icons.
Do not add constant animation or hover-only primary interactions.
Do not break generated project data, media paths, categories, statuses, links or deployment output.
Project capture galleries contain three to five labeled images and support keyboard selection, visible focus and reduced motion.
Do not upload the project to Stitch without explicit authorization.

allowedDependencies.new: No new runtime dependency is allowed unless a verified requirement cannot be met with the existing static stack.
